source_note: 2006 filing reports 88,500 lots controlled with cash and letter-of-credit deposits plus 800 JV lots separately; JV overlap with the headline controlled-lot count is not fully clear.
2007 filing reports 67,600 lots controlled with deposits and records 17,100 lots in the impairment reserve; 700 JV lots are disclosed separately.

2008 primary document was recovered from the SEC directory cache but is still missing from the Make-produced filing index; the filing reports 45,000 controlled lots and 370 LLC-controlled lots separately.
2009 filing reports 46,300 controlled lots with deposits and 760 lots controlled through two performing LLCs; later 2010 table restates 2009 total lots controlled as 46,337.
2010 filing gives first clean lots-controlled table; component prose sums to about 52,390 versus table total 52,310 because the components are rounded.
2011 table reports 52,976 total lots controlled; JV expected lots less lots not under contract gives 4,000 JV-controlled lots.
2012 table reports 58,498 total lots controlled; 53,200 LPA lots plus 4,600 JV-controlled lots plus about 700 land-under-development lots reconcile after rounding.
2013 filing discloses 125 land-under-development lots under contract to an unrelated party; total controlled-lot reconciliation is approximate because all components are rounded.
2014 starts explicit raw-land-contract disclosure; those 5,700 expected lots are stated as not included in total lots controlled.
2015 raw-land-contract expected lots are excluded from total controlled lots; February 2016 parcel acquisition is described separately and not coded as a 2015 controlled lot.
2016 component disclosure cleanly separates LPA lots from JV-controlled lots and land under development; raw-land contracts are excluded from total controlled lots.
2017 component values reconcile exactly after rounding; raw-land-contract expected lots are excluded from the total controlled-lot table.
2018 LPA plus JV-controlled plus land-under-development lots exactly match the 99,700 table total.
2019 filing states there were no specific performance obligations related to finished-lot purchases; raw-land contracts remain excluded from total controlled lots.
2020 disclosure uses LPA terminology; net impairment charges were COVID-related but this row records the year-end reserve balance.
2021 filing no longer gives one aggregate purchase-price figure for all controlled lots; future LPA deposits are disclosed separately.
2022 LPA plus JV-controlled plus land-under-development lots exactly match the 131,900 table total.
2023 values match the benchmark disclosure: 141,500 total controlled lots and 134,900 LPA lots.
2024 row uses the explicit table total of 162,400 and the LPA disclosure of 155,000 lots.
2025 filing reports 180,100 total controlled lots and a sharp increase in LPA deposits and raw-land contracts.
